Sales and Leases Practice Exams

# Sales and Leases Practice Exams

29 practice finals (870 questions), each the size of the final's 60-minute multiple-choice part: 30 questions, split into two 15-question exams (Exams 1 and 2 are Final 1, Exams 3 and 4 are Final 2, and so on). Together they cover all of syllabus Weeks 1–14 (the syllabus ends with the Week 14 review) and every section of the course outline, from which law governs and the battle of the forms through warranties, risk of loss, buyer's and seller's remedies, privity, and leases under Article 2A. Each exam follows Professor Richardson's sample-exam format: 15 stand-alone, five-choice questions that mix rule questions ("Which of the following is NOT…") with short hypos asking who wins and why, plus "None of the above" and "All of the above" choices that are sometimes the answer. Each exam runs through the whole course in outline order, and 334 questions come from the remedies and lease units in Weeks 8–14. Every choice has its own explanation. Use Study mode to check each answer as you go, or Exam mode to answer a full exam and then grade it. Pick a topic to drill one section; each topic shows its week and outline section.
